body:
Fixes #37

Automatic spacing could introduce a crossing between a link's own references, and slider clicks could leave keyboard arrows without focus. The previous PR revision also rearranged `34442132` to lower its overlap score, violating the latest feedback.

Spacing now changes only reference turns and gaps. Link colors, order, placement settings, actual rendered middle coordinates, and closed halves stay fixed through preview, Apply, sharing and image export. The permutation/compaction search and renderer layout override are removed; Apply accepts only spacing fields. The original fitting transform is retained because refitting alone could otherwise move every link by up to 6.42 image units.

The default maximum correction is 30 degrees, with .20 gap range and one-degree refinement. The suggested `.05 / 180 / 13` URL remains supported and tested without moving links. Painted-half scoring prevents the reported `2222` self crossing. Pointer-down and completed-click focus preserve native slider dragging and arrow editing, including Safari. Search runs in a cancellable worker, with pending/error status, export gating and preservation of concurrent color edits.

Validation:

- Reproduced the rejected placement changes with six failing cases before removing the global search. Added exact coordinate and closed-half invariants for both reported networks, all 20 unchanged seeded examples, and all eight placement modes.
- All 938 unit tests pass. Lint, formatting, source-tooling, documentation, dependency audit and production build pass.
- Chromium and Firefox verify click-then-page-key input, dragging, responsive worker behavior, all 22 network round trips, unchanged centers/colors, continuous paths, image bounds, exact Apply/share/SVG output, explicit settings, custom order/palette, mobile and Russian UI. All eight inherited editor suites also pass locally in both engines, including the complete 4,131-card gallery and slider keyboard audit.
- [Current-head CI passed](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/actions/runs/41052914218) for `1d39649f42418143f7e5d1530aaf75c4011d36e2`: 938 tests, the complete Chromium/Firefox/macOS WebKit matrix, all 120 CV PDFs, production build, security, tooling and documentation checks. The run started October 30 at 12:06:45 UTC, after this commit; browser artifacts verify the merge with current `main`. All 22 networks and 12 issue-specific browser checks passed in each engine, without page errors.

Fifteen of the 20 seeded networks reach zero painted residual. Five retain measured residuals (`2012`: .102, `032113`: .178, `43434143`: 6.629, `33044224`: 7.564, `31324042`: 2.333); `34442132` improves from 29.240 to 13.285. These are bounded local improvements, not a claim of perfect spacing or global optimality. Existing crossings are retained under the overriding requirement to preserve the drawing. No colors, positions or default middle cuts are changed to conceal them.

Reproduce with `/network/?code=2222&solve=true` and `/network/?code=34442132&solve=true`. Run `npm run test:ci`, `npm run check`, `npm run build`, and `npm run test:network:issue37` (also `ENGINE=firefox` / `ENGINE=webkit`). The [case study](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/README.md) contains the full requirement map, inherited-issue review, primary-source research, failing/passing logs, scripts, raw measurements and all 20 before/after pairs. Historical reordered screenshots are explicitly labeled as rejected evidence.

Final integration review: current `main` is included, the pushed branch matches the final tested commit, the working tree is clean, the complete source diff was reviewed, and all issue/PR comment types were refreshed with no further feedback. The pull request remains unmerged.

The original network and the revised automatic result retain identical colors and middle positions:

| Network | Original | Local automatic adjustment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `34442132` | ![Original four-link network](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/preserved/chromium-before-34442132.png?raw=true) | ![Fixed placement after local adjustments](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/preserved/chromium-after-34442132.png?raw=true) |
| `2222` | ![Original two-link network](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/preserved/chromium-before-2222.png?raw=true) | ![Locally spaced references without self crossing](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/preserved/chromium-after-2222.png?raw=true) |

The original reported self-crossing is also [preserved for comparison](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/reported-crossing.png?raw=true). All seeded examples: [first ten pairs](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/random-preserved-1.png?raw=true), [second ten pairs](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-37-f17145ac88b1/docs/case-studies/issue-37/screenshots/random-preserved-2.png?raw=true).
